relations.rationale: Adjusting shoelaces is a pre-race action unrelated to where Tess stood in the pack.
Adjusting shoelaces one last time is a pre-race detail with no bearing on when Dara finished relative to Tess.
Tess's position near the front doesn't determine whether the crowd surged when the horn sounded.
Standing near the front suggests Tess was positioned to finish early, making it less likely Rosa finished ahead of her, though not impossible.
Tess's starting position has no connection to laughter echoing at the finish area.
The crowd surging as the race starts naturally leads to runners' sneakers hitting the pavement rhythmically.
The crowd surging at the start has no direct bearing on volunteers packing up tables at midday, a later separate event.
Sneakers thudding during the race is unrelated to laughter echoing at the finish area afterward.
Rosa finishing slightly ahead of Tess doesn't determine when Dara finished relative to Tess.
Dara crossing the line moments after Tess directly describes the same finishing event where Dara is breathing hard and smiling.
Dara smiling after finishing is consistent with and supports the general atmosphere of laughter echoing at the finish area.
Uma finishing in the middle of the pack explains why she was already done and free to cheer for others coming in later.
Volunteers packing up by midday suggests the event is winding down, yet laughter still echoing implies ongoing festivity, creating tension but not outright impossibility.
